duster.headline: No new listings; 2022 dCi Zen (R209 990, +R24 273) is the standout bargain but manual — best criteria-matching auto diesel remains the 2022 TechRoad.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, R249 990, 47 051 km, +R12 185 — only auto+diesel+2020+ fit; KIA Ballito franchise.
2022 Zen diesel R209 990, 72 000 km, +R24 273 — biggest bargain but manual; Durban Multifranchise suits Duster trade.
2019 Dynamique Auto diesel R195 000, 88 500 km, +R5 717 — cheapest auto diesel; pre-2020, high km.

caddy.headline: Very thin market: one viable listing, the 2020 1.6 Crew Bus at R279 990/76 000 km — under both caps; verify history before committing.

shortlist.note: 2020 Crew Bus (Kombi-type, 5-seat) R279 990, 76 000 km, manual petrol — only option; priced fairly, not suspiciously cheap.

jimny.headline: Three 3-door options under caps; cheapest 2018 1.3 is R234 890/86 000 km, but the 2021 GLX with 25 115 km is the strongest buy.

shortlist.note: Cheapest: 2018 1.3 old-gen R234 890, 86 000 km — R55k under others; inspect condition carefully.
2021 GLX AllGrip R295 995, only 25 115 km — newest, lowest km; no dealer shown, verify seller.
2020 GLX AllGrip R289 890, 78 000 km — safe middle option at Jetour Ballito.

seltos.headline: First capture, 22 listings: strong auto value — 2021 1.6 EX Auto R210 000 (+R37 692) and 2023 EX Auto R274 990 (+R26 946) lead; expect movement next run.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto R210 000, 100 000 km (at cap), +R37 692; GAC Pinetown multi-franchise — Duster trade friendly.
2023 1.6 EX Auto R274 990, 44 000 km, +R26 946 — newest low-km auto; KIA Pinetown.
2022 1.6 EX+ Auto R234 900, 97 876 km, +R13 700; Durban Multifranchise trade-friendly, near km cap.

creta.headline: First capture, 26 listings: gen2 diesel autos cluster R269 900–R299 990; standout is 2024 1.5 Premium Auto R279 999 (+R26 880, 40 000 km).

shortlist.note: 2024 1.5 Premium Auto R279 999, 40 000 km, +R26 880 — newest, biggest value; petrol though.
2021 1.5D Executive Auto (gen2 diesel) R269 990, 60 099 km, +R442 — fair price, exactly the briefed diesel auto.
2021 1.6D Executive Auto R249 990, 98 000 km, +R15 610 — cheapest diesel auto but gen1 1.6D, near km cap.

hr-v.headline: First capture: thin as expected — two old-gen automatics; 2021 Comfort R249 990/57 000 km keeps the 448 L boot and Magic Seats.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.5 Comfort CVT R249 990, 57 000 km — old gen: 448 L boot, Magic Seats; matches CVT preference.
2020 1.8 Elegance Auto R298 900, 50 000 km — more power, same old-gen practicality; R49k pricier.

discovery.headline: None qualify: every candidate misses the established ≥430 L boot bar; closest is Nissan Magnite at 405 L — not worth watching.
